description: CLK1 (2m, the wanted signal is the fundamental) through a cheap low-pass filter marked 200 MHz and a measured 37 dB pad set

chain.name: LC low-pass 200MHz
chain.notes: three series inductors and four capacitors to ground (a seven-element ladder); response not yet measured

chain.name: pad set
chain.notes: measured, not the labels: the 27-33-27 ohm T pad (15 dB) in series with the BNC attenuator marked 10 dB (really 27 dB), joined with SMA/BNC adapters. Measured together without a filter on 2026-10-31 as 37.4 dB at 145 MHz (36.9 to 38.4 dB from 20 to 180 MHz).

notes: Compare with 2m-lc-bandpass-137-140MHz-37dB (the cheap band-pass). Same pad set, so levels are comparable. The pad value was measured without any filter in front of it.
